description: Na₄Mg₂P₂SO₁₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cc space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.45-3.00 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.46-2.86 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.45-3.00 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.47-2.66 Å. There are two inequivalent Mg sites. In the first Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.01-2.18 Å. In the second Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 1.98-2.25 Å. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 31-38°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.54-1.56 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 30-36°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.55-1.57 Å. S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 30-35°. There is one shorter (1.48 Å) and three longer (1.49 Å) S-O bond lengths. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Mg, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Mg, and one S atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Mg, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Mg, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Mg, and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Mg, and one S atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Mg, and one P atom to form a mixture of distorted corner, edge, and face-sharing ONa₃MgP trigonal bipyramids. In the eighth O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Mg, and one P atom to form a mixture of distorted corner, edge, and face-sharing ONa₃MgP trigonal bipyramids. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mg, and one S atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Mg, and one P atom to form a mixture of distorted corner, edge, and face-sharing ONa₃MgP trigonal bipyramids. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mg, and one S atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Mg, and one P atom to form a mixture of distorted corner, edge, and face-sharing ONa₃MgP trigonal bipyramids.
